exposure.needed: which dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count has been renamed to doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total.

decision.reason: [ev-6a341603b700] says only that Cilium renamed the metric. Nothing changes in the product's own configuration. The environments affected are the ones whose monitoring (dashboards, alerts, recording rules) still queries doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count, and no Cilium setting, values key or field shows that. So an undecidable exposure that names this need is a fair condition. The section context also gives a different new name for the same metric [ev-df8818f69d5e]. That conflict is about the change aspect, not this one, because the old name, and so the exposure, is the same either way.
